pull-request-header:
## Description

Prepare component releases together in one PR. Each component keeps its own version and changelog. Merge this PR into `dev`, then promote `dev` to `main` to publish independent component tags and GitHub releases.

```mermaid
flowchart LR
  Changes --> ReleasePR[Combined release PR]
  ReleasePR --> dev
  dev --> main
  main --> Tags[Component tags and GitHub releases]
```

## How Has This Been Tested?

| Check | Command or evidence | Status |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Backend suite | `cd backend && python manage.py test` | Unrun by release automation; record local results before merging |
| Frontend suite | `cd frontend && npm run test -- --run` | Unrun by release automation; record local results before merging |
| Release regression tests | `node --test .github/scripts/publish-releases.test.cjs` | Inspect Release Automation Tests workflow |
| CI | PR Validation workflow | Inspect actual check results separately |
| Regression scenarios | Review component changes listed above | Unrun by release automation |
